title: Appealing my ban

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Hello

"I just knock off a iron guy off the void and a bow spammer off and got the monument. Also the 2 defenders weren't looking except the iron guy but he was standing still near the edge of the void."

This isn't the reason I banned you off, rather I had been looking at you for well 10 minutes, and recorded it all. All your movements looked especially fishy, you also seemed to eat golden apples and run slightly faster than normal (like what using Timer does), but I thought my witness could have been something to do with latency, as those movements' speeds may slightly vary due to them. I would also like to inform you that knockback reducers do exist, also known as Velocity; I don't really know why I should do this, but I'll explain you how it works. Knockback is sent via packets (byte arrays of data) by the server, to the client. Some ghost (or average) minecraft clients manage to ignore those packets (aka Antiknockback), or to only take in some (velocity), or create fake packages of backwards hitting to send the player slightly forward (harder to detect by anticheats, but still knockback reducers / velocity).

My editing software has crashed many times while editing this video, especially when adding the third clip I recorded, maybe it was corrupted idk. However, I feel like the evidence put in the following video is conclusive enough.

I don't think your ping, your cps, and your pvping technique play any factor in this, so I'll just flat out ignore that part of the appeal. Is there any further rationale / explanation on these remarkably odd and fishy movements of yours?

Please, if you ever used it just don't use it anymore, and if you didn't, then I'm sorry :(

Welcome back I guess!
